blocks.text: NEW YORK — Jaylen Brown’s head is fine and he may know more about his hamstring Tuesday. Brown twice had to leave in the fourth quarter of the Philadelphia 76ers’ 135-123 victory in Brooklyn on Monday night, once after a collision opened a cut on his head and the second time because of tightness in his leg. The All-Star swingman said he had both injuries looked at Monday after matching his season high with 31 points and grabbing a season-best 13 rebounds. “My hamstring, we’ll check out again tomorrow and go from there,” Brown said.
